title: Dual Stream Stream Merger
description: A streaming platform merges two incoming chunks of text data, represented by strings s1 and s2, into a single broadcast string s3. To maintain temporal order, characters from s1 and s2 must preserve their relative order in s3. Given strings s1, s2, and s3, determine whether s3 can be formed by interleaving s1 and s2.
constraints: s1, s2, and s3 consist of lowercase English letters.
input_format: Three strings: s1, s2, and s3

examples.explanation: One way to form s3 is to take "aa" from s1, "dbbc" from s2, "bc" from s1, "a" from s2, and "c" from s1.
It is impossible to interleave s1 and s2 to form s3.
Empty strings can always be interleaved.
